title: GEMS: Agent-Native Multimodal Generation with Memory
summary: GEMS is a multi-agent framework that treats multimodal content generation as an iterative optimization task. It features a closed-loop system of planning, verification, and refinement, supported by hierarchical memory and extensible domain skills.
research_notes: Utilizes Sglang for MLLM serving and Diffusers for image generation backends; documentation is available at gems-gen.github.io.

evolution.summary: The project introduced inference-time scaling for multimodal models and a modular 'Skill' system, allowing smaller models to outperform larger proprietary ones like GPT-Image.
